primary_targets.detail: ~765 total clone-affected items: 132 currently Archived + 111 actionable Unprocessed Section F clones + ~522 S801-claimed Section A-D clone items (CERTIFIED — requires de-certification before archival). Pack B benchmark is the quality gate for fresh-authored replacements. S800 estimated 15-25 sessions; scope reduced ~20% by S801 clone count refinement.

~500 definition-match items labeled Moderate (DS=3) that test Bloom's Remember/Understand and should be Easy (DS=1). Dominant pattern: stem contains textbook definition, correct answer is the term being defined. Metadata-only edits — no content changes. DCS v1.1 governed.

All 420 case items labeled Moderate (3) with zero variance. Statistically implausible. Requires per-item cognitive assessment against CAQS §6.1 target distribution (15% Easy, 20% Mod-Easy, 30% Moderate, 25% Difficult, 10% Very Difficult).

dependency_graph.description: P0 (resolved) → P1 (clone archival + seed certification) → P3 (DL-013 cleanup, metadata) → P4 (clone replacement). P2 (Pack E enhancement, case bank) is independent of P1/P3 (different files). P4 difficulty recalibration can overlap all tiers.

dependency_graph.parallel_path: P2 can run simultaneously with P1/P3. Case bank work (P2/P4) is independent of MCQ workstreams.

key_risks.risk: Pack E full rewrite scope creep
key_risks.detail: S800 estimated 'targeted enhancement' vs. Agent I's finding that 83.6% of Pack E is definition-match format suggests near-full rewrite may be needed. 500 items at ~3-5 items per session = 100-167 sessions if done individually. Batch rewriting may reduce to 10-14 sessions but at risk of DL-013-style template boilerplate reintroduction.
key_risks.mitigation: Pack B is the quality template. Phase Pack E in 4 sections (A/B, C/D, E, F) with independent QA per phase.

key_risks.risk: S801 clone claims for A-D sections unverified
key_risks.detail: Agent J (Pack C: 347 archivable) and Agent K (Pack D: 437 archivable) claim ~414 clone items in already-Certified A-D sections. Agent P verified only E/F (300 clone-affected). A-D claims may be inflated by DL-016/DL-029 artifacts. Acting on unverified claims would require de-certification of hundreds of Certified items.
key_risks.mitigation: Require independent stem-comparison verification of A-D clone claims before any P4 archival action on Certified sections.

key_risks.detail: No file-lock protocol implemented. Prior sessions' remediation was overwritten by concurrent waves (432 items across Pack C+D). Remediation effort may be silently lost.
key_risks.mitigation: Session isolation enforced. Cross-session re-verification after every write batch.
